A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
